c74object.name: evi_rcfilters
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_rcfilters.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_rcfilters.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_rcfilters.genexpr file also requires:
evi_approx.genexpr
About this File:
Classic analog onepole RC filters in trapezoidal form. These are high quality and extremely efficient onepole filter primitives used all over evieve and very useful in day to day patching situations. One of the reasons we use trapezoidal rule is so that the filter can be correctly nonlinearised in TPT form.

entry.name: rcPreWarp1 ( )
entry.description:
Frequency warping for all onepole filters with a cheap approximation suited to lower range frequency values
In 1: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
Return 1: G, Warped frequency g coefficient 0..1

entry.name: rcPreWarp2 ( )
entry.description:
Frequency warping for all onepole filters with an approximation suited to full range frequency values
In 1: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
Return 1: G, Warped frequency g coefficient 0..HALFPI

entry.name: rcFilter ( )
entry.description:
Linear OnePole Lowpass RC filter (trapezoidal), 1 mul 1 div
In 1: type=input: Vin, Audio input
In 2: type=input: g, Normalised frequency coefficient
Return 1: Filter, Onepole filter output

entry.name: rcFilterHp ( )
entry.description:
Linear OnePole Highpass RC filter
In 1: type=input: Vin, Audio input
In 2: type=input: g, Normalised frequency coefficient
Return 1: Filter, Onepole filter output

entry.name: rcFilterLpHp ( )
entry.description:
Linear OnePole RC filter with simultaneous Lowpass/Highpass outputs
In 1: type=input: Vin, Audio input
In 2: type=input: g, Normalised frequency coefficient
Return 1: Lowpass, Lowpass filter output
Return 2: Highpass, Highpass filter output

entry.name: rcFilterLpApHp ( )
entry.description:
Linear OnePole RC filter with simultaneous Lowpass/Allpass/Highpass outputs
In 1: type=input: Vin, Audio input
In 2: type=input: g, Normalised frequency coefficient
Return 1: Lowpass, Lowpass filter output
Return 2: Allpass, Allpass filter output
Return 3: Highpass, Highpass filter output

entry.name: rcFilterAllpass ( )
entry.description:
Linear OnePole Allpass RC filter
In 1: type=input: Vin, Audio input
In 2: type=input: g, Normalised frequency coefficient
Return 1: Filter, Onepole filter output

entry.name: rcFilterBandpass ( )
entry.description:
Linear OnePole Bandpass RC filter
In 1: type=input: xp, Audio input
In 2: type=input: glp, Low band normalised frequency coefficient
In 3: type=input: ghp, High band normalised frequency coefficient
Return 1: Filter, Onepole filter output

entry.name: rcDampCoeffs ( )
entry.description:
Coefficients calculator for Onepole attenuate/boost filters, better to use individual calculators below
In 1: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: damp, Normalised damping factor -1..1
In 3: type=input: mode, Operational mode (0=attenuation only, 1=attenuate/boost shelfs, 2=lp/hp/attenuate/boost shelfs)
Return 1: G, Frequency coefficient output
Return 2: K, Gain coefficient output

entry.name: rcDampCoeffsNoTilde ( )
entry.description:
Gen no tilde schedular rate coefficients calculator for Onepole attenuate/boost filters
In 1: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: damp, Normalised damping factor -1..1
In 3: type=input: mode, Operational mode (0=attenuation only, 1=attenuate/boost shelfs, 2=lp/hp/attenuate/boost shelfs)
In 4: type=param (optional): AUDIO_SR, default: 48000, You must pass in the audio sampling rate here
Return 1: G, Frequency coefficient output
Return 2: K, Gain coefficient output

entry.name: rcDampCoeffs0 ( )
entry.description:
Coefficients calculator for Onepole Damping filters, can be used at Param rate
In 1: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: damp, Normalised damping factor 0..1, 0=flat, 1=highpass/lowpass
Return 1: G, Frequency coefficient output
Return 2: K, Gain coefficient output

entry.name: rcDampCoeffs1 ( )
entry.description:
Coefficients calculator for Onepole shelving attenuate/boost filters
In 1: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: damp, Normalised damping factor -1..1, -1=shelf attenuate, 1=shelf boost
Return 1: G, Frequency coefficient output
Return 2: K, Gain coefficient output

entry.name: rcDampCoeffs2 ( )
entry.description:
Coefficients calculator for Onepole lp/hp/attenuate/boost filters
In 1: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: damp, Normalised damping factor -1..1, -1=lp/hp, through shelfs, 1=boost shelfs
Return 1: G, Frequency coefficient output
Return 2: K, Gain coefficient output

entry.name: rcFilterDamp ( )
entry.description:
Linear OnePole Lowpass RC damp/boost filter
In 1: type=input: Vin, Audio input
In 2: type=input: g, Normalised frequency coefficient
In 3: type=input: k, Gain coefficient
Return 1: Damping filter, Onepole filter output

entry.name: rcFilterDampHp ( )
entry.description:
Linear OnePole Highpass RC damp/boost filter
In 1: type=input: Vin, Audio input
In 2: type=input: g, Normalised frequency coefficient
In 3: type=input: k, Gain coefficient
Return 1: Damping filter, Onepole filter output

entry.name: rcFilterDampLpHp ( )
entry.description:
Linear OnePole RC damp/boost filter with simultaneous LP/HP outputs
In 1: type=input: Vin, Audio input
In 2: type=input: g, Normalised frequency coefficient
In 3: type=input: k, Gain coefficient
Return 1: Damping filter, Low filter output
Return 2: Damping filter, High filter output

entry.name: rcFilterDampBandpass ( )
entry.description:
Linear OnePole Bandpass RC damp/boost filter
In 1: type=input: Vin, Audio input
In 2: type=input: glp, Low band normalised frequency coefficient
In 3: type=input: ghp, High band normalised frequency coefficient
In 4: type=input: lk, Low band gain coefficient
In 5: type=input: hk, High band gain coefficient
Return 1: Damping filter, Onepole bandpass filter output

entry.name: rcOnePole ( )
entry.description:
Nonlinear Onepole RC filter via Newton iteration
In 1: type=input: Vin, Audio input
In 2: type=input: g, Normalised frequency coefficient
Return 1: Nonlinear Onepole, Nonlinear onepole filter output
